# SOP-P3-L3-04 Shift handover - Machining line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03

Purpose: Ensure safe, complete, and auditable transfer of responsibility for the Machining line.

Preconditions:
1. Outgoing operator must complete end-of-shift checklist in the MES and clear active work orders per SOP-P3-L3-01.
2. Incoming operator must have current authorization and hands-on training records referenced in SOP-P3-L3-03.
3. Verify any engineering changes affecting line operations are acknowledged per ECN-2026-016.

Procedure:
1. Visual and functional walkdown
   - Walk the line from EQ-P3-L3-SB01 to EQ-P3-L3-HP03 and report any anomalies on the shift log.
2. Locked and tagged items
   - Confirm all locked/tagged items are recorded and status communicated.
3. Hydraulic press verification
   - Confirm the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar.
   - Verify the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m and documented on the maintenance tag if recently adjusted.
4. Tooling and die status
   - Confirm installed tooling part numbers match work order and that wear limits are communicated.
5. Quality hold and scrap
   - Notify incoming operator of any quality holds and location of suspect parts; ensure containment is intact.
6. Production targets and backlog
   - Communicate current queue, interruptions, and any required machine set-up remaining for the next shift.
7. Safety and housekeeping
   - Confirm guards, barriers, and e-stops are functional and that work area is free of tripping hazards.

PPE:
8. Required PPE for line activities: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear. Follow plant PPE policy.

Sign-off:
9. Outgoing operator signs and timestamps the paper or electronic shift log. Incoming operator reviews remarks, initials, and assumes responsibility. Retain log per document retention rules referenced in ECN-2026-016.
